columns.name: SITE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the site. System generated value.

columns.name: PREVIEW_THEME_ID
columns.description: ID of site theme which is used for preview.

columns.name: SITE_URL_NAME
columns.description: Site Display Name for URL configured by the customer in the site editor visible in the URL

columns.name: EVENTS_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Column indicating if events are enabled per site. Will be used by UI to control if events are exposed to users.

columns.name: EMAIL_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Id of the email template for the given site (foreign key to IRC_MESSAGE_DESIGNS_B)

columns.name: SITE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the Site (External or Internal). EXT - for Existing CE site, ICE - for new internal SITE

columns.name: OBJECT_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the status of the object

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SITE_CODE
columns.description: Unique site code defined by administrator.

columns.name: SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier of the site,  auto generated value.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the site informing whether site is active or not

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Order of the site on the list of sites.

columns.name: DEFAULT_LANG
columns.description: Default language in which site will be displayed.

columns.name: ACTIVE_THEME_ID
columns.description: ID of site theme which is activated for site. Column is deprecated.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.
